name: help

lines.t: Select  - click to select, drag to move (box takes its text)
Arrow   - drag; straight, or elbow (horizontal, then vertical)
Text    - click a cell, type; enter/esc finishes
Color: white red yellow green cyan magenta (+recolor)

text: DRAW  [v Select]  b Box   a Arrow   t Text   p Pen   Color  1● [2●] 3●  4●  5●  6●       ? help  ctrl+q quit
│            │ Tools                                                                  │
│            │ v      Select  - click to select, drag to move (box takes its text)    │
│            │ b      Box     - drag corner to corner                                 │
└────────────│ a      Arrow   - drag; straight, or elbow (horizontal, then vertical)  │
│ t      Text    - click a cell, type; enter/esc finishes                │
│ p      Pen     - drag to paint █ blocks                                │
│ Keys                                                                   │
│ 1-6    Color: white red yellow green cyan magenta (+recolor)           │
│ esc    Clear selection / finish text                                   │
│ del    Delete selected object (delete or backspace)                    │
│ ctrl+z Undo                                                            │
███     │ ctrl+y Redo                                                            │
█████│ ?      Toggle this help                                                │
│ ctrl+q Quit                                                            │
